//: Static site, no build step. Vercel serves the repository root as-is.
cleanUrls is deliberately OFF: every internal link is an explicit .html
path carrying a query string (model.html?m=tvs-jupiter), and cleanUrls
would add a 308 redirect hop to each of those navigations.

headers.//: CSS and JS filenames are not content-hashed, so they must revalidate or a redeploy would serve stale code against new markup.
